court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: learned Judicial Magistrate, Tambaram, Crl.M.P.No.98 of 2012 in M.C.No.24 of 2011
facts_of_case: The respondent/wife filed petition under Section 125 Cr.P.C. seeking maintenance of Rs.12,000/-, and the learned Magistrate ordered Rs.8,000/- as interim maintenance. The husband filed present revision.

legal_principles.principle: The provision for grant of maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. is summary in nature and subject to the orders of the Civil Court.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the provision for grant of maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. is summary in nature and it is subject to the orders of the Civil Court.

legal_principles.principle: The husband having sufficient means neglected to maintain his wife and if the wife is unable to maintain herself, then the wife is entitled to get maintenance from the husband.
legal_principles.held: Section 125 Cr.P.C. is very clear that the husband having sufficient means neglected to maintain his wife and if the wife is unable to maintain herself, then the wife is entitled to get maintenance from the husband.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order was set aside, and the case was remanded for fresh consideration.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
